name: shadow-vpn
description: 暗影VPN — 基于 FlowZ 的后端修复版

scripts.dev:main: node scripts/gen-build-info.js && cross-env NODE_ENV=development tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && electron .
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.package: npm run fetch:core && npm run test:core-gate && npm run fetch:dashboard && npm run build && electron-builder
scripts.package:win: npm run build:helper && npm run fetch:core && npm run test:core-gate && npm run fetch:cronet && npm run fetch:dashboard && npm run build && electron-builder --win
scripts.package:mac: npm run build:helper && npm run fetch:core && npm run test:core-gate && npm run fetch:dashboard && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --x64
scripts.package:linux: npm run build:helper && npm run fetch:core && npm run test:core-gate && npm run fetch:cronet && npm run fetch:dashboard && npm run build && electron-builder --linux --x64
scripts.package:all: npm run build:helper && npm run fetch:core && npm run test:core-gate && npm run fetch:cronet && npm run fetch:dashboard && npm run build && electron-builder --win --mac --linux
scripts.dist: npm run fetch:core && npm run test:core-gate && npm run fetch:dashboard && npm run build && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:helper && npm run fetch:core && npm run test:core-gate && npm run fetch:cronet && npm run fetch:dashboard && npm run build && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:helper && npm run fetch:core && npm run test:core-gate && npm run fetch:dashboard && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:helper && npm run fetch:core && npm run test:core-gate && npm run fetch:cronet && npm run fetch:dashboard && npm run build && electron-builder --linux --x64 --publish never
scripts.release:prepare: npm run fetch:core && npm run test:core-gate && npm run fetch:cronet && npm run fetch:dashboard && npm run build && npm run package:all
scripts.package:mac:local: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --dir

author: dododook <admin@flowz.app>
